notes: CREATIVE_BATCH_4.md 2.10/4.3/5. Own script scripts/run_cb4.py (the doc's argv named run_cb1_extract.py; moved so CB1/CB2 stay untouched, as q0060). Priority 62 (challenger ruling 6). Idempotent by capture_id + extractor version; CB1/CB2/CB3 tables untouched; processes oldest first so departures can use the previous capture's closewin. A capture gone from the host is restored from the verified release copy (restore_from_archive.py, sha256 re-checked against the catalogue) into <root>/_scratch with a 0.2 GB peak cap, scratch deleted before the next batch and at exit; no usable copy -> recorded missing (never reconstructed) and the run continues. A restore reads the whole release stream (about 20 min on the host), so one call restores as many captures as fit under 0.2 GB. Refuses with a non-zero exit while data-dumps > 10.5 GB; stops at 0.40 GB of written tables; repeat regex matches only the true backfill_complete flag (missing captures count as handled).
